evidence.title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting

summary: Researchers have introduced a dual‑stream multimodal learning framework that integrates diverse data sources to predict influenza trends over extended horizons. The approach outperforms existing models, offering a potential tool for public health planning and early warning systems.
title: New Dual-Stream Multimodal AI Model Improves Long-Term Influenza Forecasts
